source_routes.paper_title: Tarloxotinib targets tumor hypoxia to improve therapeutic efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibition in a TLR9 dependent manner

source_routes.paper_title: Impact of influenza vaccination on survival of patients with advanced cancer receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors (INVIDIa-2): final results of the multicentre, prospective, observational study

source_routes.paper_title: Immune checkpoint inhibitor-associated gastrointestinal adverse events in patients with colorectal cancer

source_routes.paper_title: Microbiome-selective DNA Pol IIIC inhibitors in oncology infection management

source_routes.paper_title: Insights into the Relationship Between the Gut Microbiome and Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors in Solid Tumors

source_routes.paper_title: Metagenomics and culturomics reveal the dual role of the gut microbiome in the development of immune-related toxicities and the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in cancer

source_routes.paper_title: Breakthroughs in immune checkpoint therapy: overcoming NSCLC immune checkpoint therapy resistance with novel techniques

source_routes.paper_title: Immunological Drug–Drug Interactions in Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Therapy: Mechanisms, Clinical Evidence, and Artificial Intelligence

source_routes.paper_title: Bacteria in cancer therapy: A new generation of weapons

source_routes.paper_title: Impact of Patient Characteristics on the Outcomes of Patients with Gastrointestinal Cancers Treated with Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors

source_routes.paper_title: Abstract A14: Meta-analysis improves identification of microbiome associations with antitumor response in melanoma, lung, and kidney cancer patients treated with checkpoint inhibitors

source_routes.paper_title: Role of the intestinal microbiome and microbial-derived metabolites in immune checkpoint blockade immunotherapy of cancer

source_routes.paper_title: Predictive impact of sarcopenia in solid cancers treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors: a meta‐analysis

source_routes.paper_title: Gut microbiota's role in NAFLD- and HBV/HCV-related hepatocellular carcinoma: Mechanisms and therapeutic implications.

source_routes.paper_title: The role of the gut microbiome in modulating immunotherapy efficacy in colorectal cancer

source_routes.paper_title: Checkpoint inhibitor responses can be regulated by the gut microbiota – A systematic review

source_routes.paper_title: Microbiota: A key factor affecting and regulating the efficacy of immunotherapy

source_routes.paper_title: The gut microbiome in lung cancer: from pathogenesis to precision therapy
